turns.question: Which channel's cost per booking rose the most from the week of 14 September 2026 to the week of 21 September, and by how many euros?
turns.answer: Social rose the most, by EUR 27.00 per booking: its cost per booking was EUR 98.00 for the week starting 14 September 2026 and EUR 125.00 for the week starting 21 September 2026 (total ad spend over total bookings in each week). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
